en.text: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.

zhSimplified.text: 当以色列中没有王的时候，有住以法莲山地那边的一个利未人，娶了一个犹大伯利恒的女子为妾。

zhTraditional.text: 當以色列中沒有王的時候，有住以法蓮山地那邊的一個利未人，娶了一個猶大伯利恆的女子為妾。

en.text: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.

zhSimplified.text: 妾行淫离开丈夫，回犹大的伯利恒，到了父家，在那里住了四个月。

zhTraditional.text: 妾行淫離開丈夫，回猶大的伯利恆，到了父家，在那裏住了四個月。

en.text: Her husband arose and went after her to speak kindly to her, to bring her again, having his servant with him and a couple of donkeys. She brought him into her father’s house; and when the father of the young lady saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

zhSimplified.text: 她丈夫起来，带着一个仆人、两匹驴去见她，用好话劝她回来。女子就引丈夫进入父家。她父见了那人，便欢欢喜喜地迎接。

zhTraditional.text: 她丈夫起來，帶着一個僕人、兩匹驢去見她，用好話勸她回來。女子就引丈夫進入父家。她父見了那人，便歡歡喜喜地迎接。

en.text: His father-in-law, the young lady’s father, kept him there; and he stayed with him three days. So they ate and drank, and stayed there.

zhSimplified.text: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父亲，将那人留下住了三天。于是二人一同吃喝、住宿。

zhTraditional.text: 那人的岳父，就是女子的父親，將那人留下住了三天。於是二人一同吃喝、住宿。

en.text: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he rose up to depart. The young lady’s father said to his son-in-law, “Strengthen your heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward you shall go your way.”

zhSimplified.text: 到第四天，利未人清早起来要走，女子的父亲对女婿说：「请你吃点饭，加添心力，然后可以行路。」

zhTraditional.text: 到第四天，利未人清早起來要走，女子的父親對女婿說：「請你吃點飯，加添心力，然後可以行路。」

en.text: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”

zhSimplified.text: 于是二人坐下一同吃喝。女子的父亲对那人说：「请你再住一夜，畅快你的心。」

zhTraditional.text: 於是二人坐下一同吃喝。女子的父親對那人說：「請你再住一夜，暢快你的心。」

en.text: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

zhSimplified.text: 那人起来要走，他岳父强留他，他又住了一宿。

zhTraditional.text: 那人起來要走，他岳父強留他，他又住了一宿。

en.text: He arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart; and the young lady’s father said, “Please strengthen your heart and stay until the day declines;” and they both ate.

zhSimplified.text: 到第五天，他清早起来要走，女子的父亲说：「请你吃点饭，加添心力，等到日头偏西再走。」于是二人一同吃饭。

zhTraditional.text: 到第五天，他清早起來要走，女子的父親說：「請你吃點飯，加添心力，等到日頭偏西再走。」於是二人一同吃飯。

en.text: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws toward evening, please stay all night. Behold, the day is ending. Stay here, that your heart may be merry; and tomorrow go on your way early, that you may go home.”

zhSimplified.text: 那人同他的妾和仆人起来要走，他岳父，就是女子的父亲，对他说：「看哪，日头偏西了，请你再住一夜；天快晚了，可以在这里住宿，畅快你的心。明天早早起行回家去。」

zhTraditional.text: 那人同他的妾和僕人起來要走，他岳父，就是女子的父親，對他說：「看哪，日頭偏西了，請你再住一夜；天快晚了，可以在這裏住宿，暢快你的心。明天早早起行回家去。」

en.text: But the man wouldn’t stay that night, but he rose up and went near Jebus (also called Jerusalem). With him were a couple of saddled donkeys. His concubine also was with him.

zhSimplified.text: 那人不愿再住一夜，就备上那两匹驴，带着妾起身走了，来到耶布斯的对面（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。）

zhTraditional.text: 那人不願再住一夜，就備上那兩匹驢，帶着妾起身走了，來到耶布斯的對面（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷。）

en.text: When they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said to his master, “Please come and let’s enter into this city of the Jebusites, and stay in it.”

zhSimplified.text: 临近耶布斯的时候，日头快要落了，仆人对主人说：「我们不如进这耶布斯人的城里住宿。」

zhTraditional.text: 臨近耶布斯的時候，日頭快要落了，僕人對主人說：「我們不如進這耶布斯人的城裏住宿。」

en.text: His master said to him, “We won’t enter into the city of a foreigner that is not of the children of Israel; but we will pass over to Gibeah.”

zhSimplified.text: 主人回答说：「我们不可进不是以色列人住的外邦城，不如过到基比亚去」；

zhTraditional.text: 主人回答說：「我們不可進不是以色列人住的外邦城，不如過到基比亞去」；

en.text: He said to his servant, “Come and let’s draw near to one of these places; and we will lodge in Gibeah, or in Ramah.”

zhSimplified.text: 又对仆人说：「我们可以到一个地方，或住在基比亚，或住在拉玛。」

zhTraditional.text: 又對僕人說：「我們可以到一個地方，或住在基比亞，或住在拉瑪。」

en.text: So they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down on them near Gibeah, which belongs to Benjamin.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就往前走。将到便雅悯的基比亚，日头已经落了；

zhTraditional.text: 他們就往前走。將到便雅憫的基比亞，日頭已經落了；

en.text: They went over there, to go in to stay in Gibeah. He went in, and sat down in the street of the city; for there was no one who took them into his house to stay.

zhSimplified.text: 他们进入基比亚要在那里住宿，就坐在城里的街上，因为无人接他们进家住宿。

zhTraditional.text: 他們進入基比亞要在那裏住宿，就坐在城裏的街上，因為無人接他們進家住宿。

en.text: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.

zhSimplified.text: 晚上，有一个老年人从田间做工回来。他原是以法莲山地的人，住在基比亚；那地方的人却是便雅悯人。

zhTraditional.text: 晚上，有一個老年人從田間做工回來。他原是以法蓮山地的人，住在基比亞；那地方的人卻是便雅憫人。

en.text: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the wayfaring man in the street of the city; and the old man said, “Where are you going? Where did you come from?”

zhSimplified.text: 老年人举目看见客人坐在城里的街上，就问他说：「你从哪里来？要往哪里去？」

zhTraditional.text: 老年人舉目看見客人坐在城裏的街上，就問他說：「你從哪裏來？要往哪裏去？」

en.text: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to the LORD’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.

zhSimplified.text: 他回答说：「我们从犹大的伯利恒来，要往以法莲山地那边去。我原是那里的人，到过犹大的伯利恒，现在我往耶和华的殿去，在这里无人接我进他的家。

zhTraditional.text: 他回答說：「我們從猶大的伯利恆來，要往以法蓮山地那邊去。我原是那裏的人，到過猶大的伯利恆，現在我往耶和華的殿去，在這裏無人接我進他的家。

en.text: Yet there is both straw and feed for our donkeys; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for your servant, and for the young man who is with your servants. There is no lack of anything.”

zhSimplified.text: 其实我有粮草可以喂驴，我与我的妾，并我的仆人，有饼有酒，并不缺少什么。」

zhTraditional.text: 其實我有糧草可以餵驢，我與我的妾，並我的僕人，有餅有酒，並不缺少甚麼。」

en.text: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”

zhSimplified.text: 老年人说：「愿你平安！你所需用的我都给你，只是不可在街上过夜。」

zhTraditional.text: 老年人說：「願你平安！你所需用的我都給你，只是不可在街上過夜。」

en.text: So he brought him into his house, and gave the donkeys fodder. Then they washed their feet, and ate and drank.

zhSimplified.text: 于是领他们到家里，喂上驴，他们就洗脚吃喝。

zhTraditional.text: 於是領他們到家裏，餵上驢，他們就洗腳吃喝。

en.text: As they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain wicked fellows, surrounded the house, beating at the door; and they spoke to the master of the house, the old man, saying, “Bring out the man who came into your house, that we can have sex with him!”

zhSimplified.text: 他们心里正欢畅的时候，城中的匪徒围住房子，连连叩门，对房主老人说：「你把那进你家的人带出来，我们要与他交合。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們心裏正歡暢的時候，城中的匪徒圍住房子，連連叩門，對房主老人說：「你把那進你家的人帶出來，我們要與他交合。」

en.text: The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly; since this man has come into my house, don’t do this folly.

zhSimplified.text: 那房主出来对他们说：「弟兄们哪，不要这样作恶；这人既然进了我的家，你们就不要行这丑事。

zhTraditional.text: 那房主出來對他們說：「弟兄們哪，不要這樣作惡；這人既然進了我的家，你們就不要行這醜事。

en.text: Behold, here is my virgin daughter and his concubine. I will bring them out now. Humble them, and do with them what seems good to you; but to this man don’t do any such folly.”

zhSimplified.text: 我有个女儿，还是处女，并有这人的妾，我将她们领出来任凭你们玷辱她们，只是向这人不可行这样的丑事。」

zhTraditional.text: 我有個女兒，還是處女，並有這人的妾，我將她們領出來任憑你們玷辱她們，只是向這人不可行這樣的醜事。」

en.text: But the men wouldn’t listen to him; so the man grabbed his concubine, and brought her out to them; and they had sex with her, and abused her all night until the morning. When the day began to dawn, they let her go.

zhSimplified.text: 那些人却不听从他的话。那人就把他的妾拉出去交给他们，他们便与她交合，终夜凌辱她，直到天色快亮才放她去。

zhTraditional.text: 那些人卻不聽從他的話。那人就把他的妾拉出去交給他們，他們便與她交合，終夜凌辱她，直到天色快亮才放她去。

en.text: Then the woman came in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man’s house where her lord was, until it was light.

zhSimplified.text: 天快亮的时候，妇人回到她主人住宿的房门前，就仆倒在地，直到天亮。

zhTraditional.text: 天快亮的時候，婦人回到她主人住宿的房門前，就仆倒在地，直到天亮。

en.text: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

zhSimplified.text: 早晨，她的主人起来开了房门，出去要行路，不料那妇人仆倒在房门前，两手搭在门槛上；

zhTraditional.text: 早晨，她的主人起來開了房門，出去要行路，不料那婦人仆倒在房門前，兩手搭在門檻上；

en.text: He said to her, “Get up, and let’s get going!” but no one answered. Then he took her up on the donkey; and the man rose up, and went to his place.

zhSimplified.text: 就对妇人说：「起来，我们走吧！」妇人却不回答。那人便将她驮在驴上，起身回本处去了。

zhTraditional.text: 就對婦人說：「起來，我們走吧！」婦人卻不回答。那人便將她馱在驢上，起身回本處去了。

en.text: When he had come into his house, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, and divided her, limb by limb, into twelve pieces, and sent her throughout all the borders of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 到了家里，用刀将妾的尸身切成十二块，使人拿着传送以色列的四境。

zhTraditional.text: 到了家裏，用刀將妾的屍身切成十二塊，使人拿着傳送以色列的四境。

en.text: It was so, that all who saw it said, “Such a deed has not been done or seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt to this day! Consider it, take counsel, and speak.”

zhSimplified.text: 凡看见的人都说：「从以色列人出埃及地，直到今日，这样的事没有行过，也没有见过。现在应当思想，大家商议当怎样办理。」

zhTraditional.text: 凡看見的人都說：「從以色列人出埃及地，直到今日，這樣的事沒有行過，也沒有見過。現在應當思想，大家商議當怎樣辦理。」
